inv.label: For micro-investors & angels
inv.title: Introduction with prospects
inv.sub: Short narrative. Approximate market context. Sources named. Not a prospectus.
inv.disclaimer: Disclaimer. Figures below are approximate third-party industry estimates for adjacent markets — not AIMarket revenue, ARR, or a promise of capture. Methodologies differ across firms (sometimes by an order of magnitude). Treat as orientation for the room; verify primary reports before diligence. This page is not an offer to sell securities.
inv.h2: Physical truth → agent economy → vertical capture
inv.p1: The scarce layer is not another chatbot. It is rails where agents buy facts about the world, pay per call, and settle only when the fact is honest.
inv.p2: We already ship GAIA (attested IoT), Pay-on-Verified, ATLAS (LIVE vs SIM), Hub, oracles, and operator glass — live URLs above. Capital accelerates volume on those rails and thin entry products (wedges) into verticals that already spend on physical-world data.
inv.pdoor: Incumbents sell forecasts and dashboards. Gaps we productize: per-reading attestation, agent-native micro-billing, economic end for bad data (refund / silence), and honest LIVE vs SIM for humans.
inv.r2b: Visibility software ~low–mid $B; broader SCM tens of $B
inv.r3b: Large fragmented (intensity, DR, metering) — treat as $10B+ opportunity class
inv.r4b: Broad GRC/ESG tooling often cited in tens of $B
inv.tamNote: These are input markets apps plug into — not our booked ARR.
inv.src1: Parametric insurance growth commentary citing Global Market Insights / Allied Market Research / Market.US ranges — Society of Actuaries overview: SOA (Jan 2026). Note: SOA authors stress veracity of marketing-research projections varies.
inv.src2: Parametric market sizing examples: Mordor Intelligence (different definition → much smaller $B) vs broader premium narratives — use the spread as a caution.
inv.src3: Supply chain visibility software: Future Market Insights (~$3.5B in 2026 → ~$12B by 2036 class).
inv.src4: Broader supply chain management: Grand View Research (SCM ~$26B in 2024 → ~$49B by 2030 class).
inv.src5: Live product surfaces (primary, not TAM): GAIA · ATLAS · Hub.
inv.pbuy: Category ownership of agent-native physical oracle + settlement — with a map into insurance, supply chain, energy, compliance, and insight agents. We do not need to be the insurer on day one.
inv.pdata: Diligence starts from the live rails and named sources on this page — not an offline pack.

idea.weather-risk.title: Weather Risk Analyst
idea.weather-risk.teaser: Buy a $0.001 reading. Sell a versioned risk report with a receipt.
idea.weather-risk.lead: Rails are live today — buy weather, verify on GAIA, see LIVE on ATLAS. The risk-report product layer is what you build on top.
idea.weather-risk.artifact: Artifact: versioned risk report (score + drivers) + attestation receipt.
idea.weather-risk.not: Not: insurance payouts or a certified forecast service.
idea.weather-risk.hard: Hard bit: LIVE coverage or explicit degrade/refuse — never silent SIM dressed as LIVE. Touch the live path below first — nothing offline to request.
idea.fire-hotspot.title: Wildfire + Weather Desk
idea.fire-hotspot.teaser: Buy atlas.fire.weather@v1 — FIRMS hotspots fused with nearest LIVE wind/humidity.
idea.fire-hotspot.lead: ATLAS composite SKU is live — cluster of NASA FIRMS hotspots + nearest weather context + content receipt. Margin is the desk note, not the CSV. Cite NASA FIRMS.
idea.fire-hotspot.who: Who pays: utilities, land ops, and reinsurance desks that already buy wildfire intel.
idea.fire-hotspot.artifact: Artifact: scored fire+weather note (hotspots[], weather citation, drivers, sha256 receipt).
idea.fire-hotspot.not: Not: evacuation authority, firefighting dispatch, or insurance payouts.
idea.fire-hotspot.hard: Hard bit: cite NASA FIRMS; refuse when no LIVE fire in bbox — never pad with SIM.
idea.situation-brief.title: Situation Brief (ATLAS > parts)
idea.situation-brief.teaser: One bbox → multi-layer scored brief with LIVE citations. What only ATLAS can sell.
idea.situation-brief.lead: SKU atlas.situation.brief@v1 fuses fire, weather, quake, jamming and more inside a bbox — score, drivers, citations, receipt. Fail-closed if no LIVE coverage.
idea.situation-brief.who: Who pays: site ops, brokers, and risk agents that need a fileable brief — not another raw sensor poll.
idea.situation-brief.artifact: Artifact: versioned situation brief (score + drivers + citations[]) + sha256 receipt.
idea.situation-brief.not: Not: a forecast service, insurance adjuster, or chat without an artifact.
idea.situation-brief.hard: Hard bit: honest refuse when LIVE pins are missing; cross-layer claims must cite ids.
idea.nearest-read.title: Nearest LIVE by coordinates
idea.nearest-read.teaser: Buy atlas.nearest.read@v1 — lat/lon → nearest LIVE pin, distance_km, receipt.
idea.nearest-read.lead: What GAIA cannot sell honestly: buyer geography on fixed sensors stays operator-anchored. ATLAS indexes the map and returns the nearest LIVE pin (layer filter, max_km). Fail-closed if nothing LIVE is in range.
idea.nearest-read.who: Who pays: agents and apps that already know a site lat/lon and need one attested reading — not a device_id scavenger hunt.
idea.nearest-read.artifact: Artifact: nearest pin citation (values + distance_km + layer) + sha256 receipt; optional per_layer map.
idea.nearest-read.not: Not: a geocoder, forecast, or a substitute for GAIA device_id custody on fixed relays.
idea.nearest-read.hard: Hard bit: refuse when coverage is empty or beyond max_km — never invent a “nearby” SIM pin.
idea.gnss-jamming-alert.title: GNSS Interference Alert
idea.gnss-jamming-alert.teaser: Turn attested GNSS interference events into signed AlertEvents for fleet / maritime risk agents.
idea.gnss-jamming-alert.lead: Rails exist — gaia.jamming.read@v1 (CC BY 4.0) + ATLAS layer. Commercial GNSS-interference desks already spend; your wedge is agent-native alerts with receipts — not ATC.
idea.gnss-jamming-alert.who: Who pays: fleet telematics, maritime, and logistics risk ops (not NGOs).
idea.gnss-jamming-alert.not: Not: spectrum regulator, ATC, or guaranteed detection.
idea.gnss-jamming-alert.hard: Hard bit: curated events are sparse vs commercial feeds — sell policy + receipt when LIVE, refuse when silent; CC BY attribution required. Chip stays idea until density + a design partner prove willingness-to-pay.
idea.sensor-publisher.title: Sensor publisher kit
idea.sensor-publisher.teaser: Attested relay → GAIA capability → ATLAS LIVE pin → first paid invoke.
idea.sensor-publisher.lead: Supply path is live: map → capability → Hub. Keys, LIVE/SIM discipline, and listing are the build.
idea.sensor-publisher.hard: Hard bit: key custody, calibration, LIVE/SIM enforcement, cold-start buyers. Start on the live map — not an offline brief.
idea.parametric-trigger.title: Parametric TriggerEvent
idea.parametric-trigger.teaser: Threshold on attested readings → signed event for an MGA partner.
idea.parametric-trigger.lead: We stay oracle + settlement rails. The partner pays claims.
idea.parametric-trigger.not: Not: paying claims or acting as adjuster.
idea.parametric-trigger.hard: Hard bit: policy-as-data, quorum, partner adapters, dispute window.
idea.evidence-export.title: Evidence export API
idea.evidence-export.teaser: Time-bounded signed packs auditors can verify offline.
idea.evidence-export.lead: Monetize streams you already publish — one beachhead framework, not full GRC.
idea.evidence-export.artifact: Artifact: signed interval pack + offline verify instructions.
idea.evidence-export.hard: Hard bit: retention, legal hold, named beachhead (e.g. cold-chain evidence).
idea.capability-15.title: Capability in 15 minutes
idea.capability-15.teaser: One HTTP endpoint → Hub manifest → first paid invoke.
idea.capability-15.lead: The marketplace loop in miniature. Rails are live; demand is the hard part.
idea.capability-15.who: Who pays: agents / apps that invoke you.
idea.capability-15.hard: Hard bit: stake / verify on production Hub; cold-start discovery.
idea.hub-embed.title: Hub embed widget
idea.hub-embed.teaser: Drop a capability storefront on any site — pay-per-call on Hub rails.
idea.hub-embed.lead: PLG for sites that want agent-native checkout without building billing.
idea.hub-embed.who: Who pays: site owners; buyers pay per invoke.
idea.warden-mcp.title: WARDEN for your MCP stack
idea.warden-mcp.teaser: Gate third-party tools before they touch your agent.
idea.warden-mcp.who: Who pays: operators with external MCP tools.
idea.warden-mcp.hard: Hard bit: policy UX and false positives.
idea.metis-answers.title: Metis verified answers
idea.metis-answers.teaser: OpenAI-compatible API with a fail-closed confidence gate.
idea.metis-answers.lead: A verifier envelope your pipeline can refuse.
idea.metis-answers.who: Who pays: apps / Factory needing verified cognition.
idea.metis-answers.hard: Hard bit: latency/cost vs raw LLM — gate, not toy.
idea.awr-receipts.title: AWR work receipts
idea.awr-receipts.teaser: Signed WorkReceipt — paste and verify offline.
idea.awr-receipts.lead: Attribution for counterparties: who said it.
idea.awr-receipts.who: Who pays: teams proving AI work provenance.
idea.awr-receipts.not: Not: proof the claim is true — attribution, not truth.
idea.factory-oneshot.title: Brief → shippable product
idea.factory-oneshot.teaser: AI-Factory: one prompt to a web product you can open.
idea.factory-oneshot.lead: Already live — a use-case card, not vapor.
idea.factory-oneshot.who: Who pays: creators shipping a first web surface fast.
idea.factory-oneshot.not: Not: arbitrary production SaaS from one sentence.
idea.factory-oneshot.hard: Hard bit: scope honesty — wow demo vs long-lived ops.
idea.fair-draw.title: Fair draw / VRF pattern
idea.fair-draw.teaser: Unfakeable randomness — Lottery is the living consumer.
idea.fair-draw.lead: Steal the pattern. Don’t build a casino.
idea.fair-draw.hard: Hard bit: clear “fair” rules in your app.
idea.momus-gate.title: MOMUS → deploy gate
idea.momus-gate.teaser: Red-team finding + bounty → DeployOrder only when fixed.
idea.momus-gate.who: Who pays: ops on SKOPOS / Factory fleets.
idea.momus-gate.hard: Hard bit: narrow buyer; needs a real fleet.
